items.title: 67395_Vic Dickenson oral history interview
items.q: you started playing with Sidney Bechet and Sidney De Paris

ctx.x: Yeah, he was a marvelous musician. And he played lead and wrote...

He could play anything. He could play anything. I don't know why... This is... There's several guys that no one seems to...everyone seems to forget about. There's Rex Stewart. There's another guy that was a genius on the trumpet. He really was. I mean, I'm not taking anything away from anybody. But you know, he was just a great guy, and... Like Jabbo Smith was a great trumpet player. Like Sidney De Paris. And all those guys, you know... People seem to forget them, you know what I mean? It just that, 'Oh, well,…
Yes. Well, that seems to have happened quite a lot in the history of this music.
